pages.text: Lay the pieces on the anvil in the recipe's pattern (as on a crafting table), the blueprint in its slot if the recipe wants one, and right-click with the hammer.

Each recipe needs some number of hits. Where the minigame is on, a marker sweeps across a bar: strike when it is in the middle. $(thing)Perfect$() and $(thing)good$() hits raise the quality, $(thing)misses$() lower it.
With $(item)Hands-On Overgeared$() the pieces lie on the anvil itself and you strike in rhythm with the hammer in your hand. Sneak-click for Overgeared's own screen.
